markdown:
The following are market listings for modifications that can be purchased for a weapon in Neon City. A weapon may only have one modification applied to it at any given time, unless otherwise stated (such as with the Suppressor and Subsonic Rounds).

| Modification Name | Cost | Usable By |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Suppressor and Subsonic Rounds](/wmod:suppressor-and-subsonic-rounds) | $$300,000 | *Ranged weapons* |
| [Long Distance Scope and Barrel](/wmod:long-distance-scope-and-barrel) | $$300,000 | *Ranged weapons* |
| [Red Dot Sight](/wmod:red-dot-sight) | $$300,000 | *Ranged weapons* |
| [Nails](/wmod:nails) | $$250,000 | *Melee weapons (bludgeoning)* |
| [Sharpened Edges](/wmod:sharpened-edges) | $$250,000 | *Melee weapons (piercing)* |
| [Dulled Side](/wmod:dulled-side) | $$250,000 | *Melee weapons (slashing)* |
